Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. There multiple classes of flaws within this product including arbitrary file creation, null char truncation and directory traversal. Null injection and directory traversal can be used in the form data passed to \Inetpub\wwwroot\hpmpa\jobDelivery\Default.asp to remotely create arbitrary files. Hewlett-Packard has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
